title: Deductible Schedule of the Travel Protection Plans
content:
Each of the Travel Protection Plans carries a general deductible, withheld from a settlement where the
benefit settled under names no deductible of its own, and a ceiling on the total deductible withheld across all
claims on one policy.

| Plan | General deductible for each claim | Ceiling on deductible across one policy |
|---|---|---|
| Trip Basics Essential | 100 | 300 |
| Trip Basics Standard | 75 | 225 |
| TripGuard Plus | 50 | 150 |
| TripGuard Premier | 0 | 0 |
| Cancel For Any Reason Elite | 0 | 0 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Traveller | 50 | 150 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Executive | 0 | 0 |

Amounts are in USD. On the three plans whose figures are 0 nothing is withheld under the general deductible and
the policy ceiling is likewise nothing.

## The relation between the two figures

On every plan that carries a general deductible the policy ceiling is three times it: 100 against 300 on Trip
Basics Essential, 75 against 225 on Trip Basics Standard, and 50 against 150 on both TripGuard Plus and Annual
Multi-Trip Traveller. TripGuard Premier, Cancel For Any Reason Elite and Annual Multi-Trip Executive carry
neither. A policy on Trip Basics Standard from which 75 has already been withheld on each of two settlements
therefore has 75 of its 225 ceiling still unused; the two settlements in that illustration are hypothetical.
